mapper.select: select mn.* from Sec_Expert_Appeal_Dtl mn where mn.Sea_Id=#{id} order by mn.Sead_Sort asc

select ex.Ex_Name as exName, ex.Ex_Id_Type as exIdType, ex.Ex_Id_Number as exIdNumber, sec.Sec_Name as secName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, mn.* from Sec_Expert_Appeal mn left join Sec_Expert ex on ex.Ex_Id=mn.Ex_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on mn.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id where mn.id=#{id}
